title: N0 Emeralds
description: This mod removes all emeralds from Minecraft, so you can’t mine them, find them, or use them for trading. Villagers become way harder to work with, and progression slows down a lot.
body: No Emeralds deletes emerald ore, emerald drops, and all emerald-based trades. Villagers won’t accept emeralds, won’t give them, and their entire trading system becomes useless or broken depending on how your mod handles it. Chest loot won’t generate emeralds, mining won’t give you any, and raids won’t drop them. This forces players to survive without trading, relying fully on crafting, looting, and farming instead. It completely changes village gameplay and makes the world feel more grindy and unforgiving.
